notes.title: ”Guardian of the Rebellion” demo version released!
notes.notes:
War story simulation RPG "Guardian of Rebellion"
The trial version was released today.

This work is a full-scale simulation RPG that depicts the story of a war over the hegemony of the continent, with the protagonist "Arzes", a young man who inherits the blood of the guardian.

In the trial version, you can play the story and battle parts from the prologue to the sixth chapter.

■ A variety of characters appear from the beginning, and their backgrounds and beliefs intersect.

■ The story is structured so that some characters' pasts are also touched upon.

■ In addition, the conversation and scenario parts have a lot of text, so those who value the story should be satisfied.

■ The battle map is also structured to be challenging from the beginning, and you can enjoy tactics that are worthy of challenge.

📌 Please send us your opinions and feedback in store reviews or on X (formerly Twitter).

We will use them in future updates and the final version.

🔗The demo version's Steam store page is here 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583730
